tools.name: resolve_issuer
tools.description: Find a listed company by ticker, ISIN or LEI and return its record summary, node and current version.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Return the full Capital Markets Record for an issuer, with per-field source, reader and state; optionally a prior version.

tools.name: list_events_since
tools.description: Return dated, URL'd disclosure events for an issuer (regulatory announcements, registry filings, releases, bulletins, halts, corporate actions, statement and record dates) since a date.

tools.name: list_aliases
tools.description: Return the sourced trade and former names an issuer releases under.

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: Return the twelve market nodes, which are live, and their record counts.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_events_since" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return dated, URL'd disclosure events for an issuer (releases, bulletins, halts, corporate actions, statement and record dates) since a date." → after: "Return dated, URL'd disclosure events for an issuer (regulatory announcements, registry filings, releases, bulletins, halts, corporate actions, statement and record dates) since a date."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
